usedFor: Roma holds tasks and notes, and Keka holds HR records, so “Updated Task Status” can start “Add an new employee”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Task Status” in Roma, then “Add an new employee” in Keka
bestTemplate.why: Moving a task to a chosen status can create the employee with personal details, job and salary.

watchOut: “Add an new employee” takes personal, job and salary details, so confirm the Roma item carries them before it runs.
